name: claude_code_5_step_bootstrap
summary: Sequential 5-prompt execution via Claude Code CLI to compile a complete local JARVIS web assistant.
steps: Install Claude Code CLI and Google Chrome on Mac.
Obtain Anthropic API key from console.anthropic.com.
Open Claude Code in a clean folder and execute Prompt 1 to build the localhost UI and 3D graph visualizer.
Execute Prompts 2 through 5 in order to add voice, memory, butler persona, and UI/TTS customization.
jarvis_use: Bootstrap local voice assistant web app from prompt packs using Claude Code.

name: chrome_web_speech_wake_word_listener
summary: Continuous background listening loop in Google Chrome using Web Speech API with wake-word detection.
steps: Request microphone permissions in Google Chrome.
Initialize continuous SpeechRecognition listening loop.
Match transcript against wake word trigger 'Jarvis'.
Pass captured command to LLM when trigger word is recognized.
jarvis_use: Enable hands-free continuous wake-word voice interface in web HUD.

name: markdown_timestamped_memory_persistence
summary: Appends timestamped context entries to local jarvis-memory.md file upon hearing explicit store commands.
steps: Detect trigger phrase 'remember...' in user speech input.
Extract target text or fact from spoken utterance.
Append date, timestamp, and context entry to jarvis-memory.md.
Read jarvis-memory.md into system context window on initialization.
jarvis_use: Maintain transparent, human-readable long-term persistent memory across sessions.

name: telegram_bot_crm_invoice_email_automation
summary: Remote Telegram bot trigger that looks up leads in Google Sheets, builds Google Drive PDF invoices, and drafts emails in Gmail.
steps: Send voice or text command specifying lead name to Telegram bot.
Query Google Sheets CRM table to retrieve lead contact details.
Generate formatted PDF invoice and save to Google Drive.
Reply in Telegram with direct download link.
Draft payment request email with invoice reference in Gmail.
jarvis_use: Automate CRM lookups, document creation, and draft emails from mobile messaging commands.

name: threejs_3d_force_graph_hud_visualizer
summary: Interactive 3D force-directed node graph mapping notes, concepts, and tools onto a dark starfield canvas.
steps: Parse local markdown files, tools, and skills into graph node objects.
Render interactive 3D force-directed canvas with visual links.
Provide HUD category filters (Router, Wiki, Concepts, Suites, Skills, Tools, Worlds, Notes, Files) and force sliders (Repel, Line length).
Display status orb indicating current state (#LISTENING, #SPEAKING, #ONLINE).
jarvis_use: Provide visual feedback HUD and interactive 3D second brain visualizer.

name: time_aware_butler_persona_prompting
summary: Configures assistant system prompt to alter greetings dynamically based on local time and user context.
steps: Check system clock during context assembly.
Select greeting variant based on time ('Good morning, sir' vs 'Burning the midnight oil, sir?').
Combine butler persona tone with contextual checks against stored notes.
jarvis_use: Inject time-aware butler persona dynamics into conversational system prompts.

name: voice_command_hud_theme_and_tts_rotation
summary: Voice-controlled HUD theme color cycling and browser TTS voice rotation.
steps: Listen for voice commands 'change your look' or 'change your voice'.
If 'change your look', cycle central HUD orb color through emerald, gold, and crimson.
If 'change your voice', cycle through top registered local Web Speech API TTS English voices.
jarvis_use: Implement hands-free UI theme switching and speech voice switching.

name: conversational_error_feedback_recovery
summary: Pass runtime execution errors directly back into agent CLI for automatic code repair.
steps: Detect application failure or permission block.
Copy error log or describe exact issue symptoms.
Prompt Claude Code CLI with standardized template: 'Something's wrong with my Jarvis. Here's what happened: [describe it]. Fix it.'
Allow agent CLI to inspect codebase, edit files, and resolve runtime error.
jarvis_use: Self-heal agent runtime errors by feeding verbatim error reports back into the agentic compiler.

name: webrtc_tab_screen_share_vision_analysis
summary: Shares browser tab view via WebRTC capture API to feed live frames into LLM vision analysis.
steps: Invoke browser screen share dialog to capture Chrome Tab or Window frame buffer.
Stream captured video frame buffer to localhost backend.
Combine captured visual frames with user voice queries.
Pass combined multimodal prompt to LLM vision model for live tab inspection.
jarvis_use: Enable real-time visual inspection of active browser tabs and desktop windows.

name: model_brain_selector_hot_swapping
summary: Model switching interface allowing runtime selection between model backends.
steps: Expose active model selector dropdown badge in HUD UI.
Allow selection between configured LLM backends (Opus, Grok, GPT).
Route subsequent user prompt payload to selected API endpoint handler.
jarvis_use: Provide dynamic runtime switching between reasoning engines in assistant backend.
